propositions: A new advisory AGENT-tier CONTAINER criterion 'decomp-shape' must be added to detect decomposition-shape smells (layer-cake architectural-layer splits and consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge) that existing G3/G4 coverage and consistency criteria do not target.

The criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER, routed with advisory posture and container facet, added to CONTAINER_CRITERIA at pass1.py, and include a rubric prompt with sub-answers 'has_container_decomposition' and 'decomposition_shape_sound'.
The eval_solver container-arm must be extended to run container criteria over fixture children lists via pass1_container, enabling bounded sanity calibration of decomp-shape without batch evaluation.

Promotion from advisory to blocking posture is deferred until E6's order-stability (fleiss_kappa currently 0.55 < 0.6 floor) clears threshold AND criterion effectiveness metrics (detection_proxy, blocking_fp_proxy) meet thresholds via the standing recorder.

Deterministic unit tests, hand-authored sanity fixtures (layer-cake positive, consumed-artifact positive, vertical-slice negative, ordered negative), and documentation of the promotion gate must all pass before landing.
